rows.en: Target destroyed.
Looks like I took it out.
That much is a given.
My shield's been destroyed.
No! My shield was destroyed!?
It's only the shield! I can still fight!
rows.notes: Transcript "shiirudo kurai" = "shiirudo kurai nara mada" (if it is just the shield...).

rows.en: Damage like this is no problem.
I'm fine! I can still fight!
You've got some nerve.
It's too early to start whining.
This is starting to be no laughing matter.
This situation is bad.
At this rate, I'm a rat in a trap.
I can't exactly call this a good situation.
I can't give up that easily...
Like I'd let them beat me!
Is there nothing I can do...?
I'll bet on whatever chance is left, however slim.
Looks like this is as far as I go.
I'm hit! The rest is up to you!
It can't end like this... No...
Do you want to die?
Stop this foolishness!
Get out of there, now!
That's what reckless gets you!
Eject, now!
That idiot!
Thank you for the reinforcements.
Looks like the tide is with us.
These reinforcements should turn the battle.
How could this happen!?
No... how could this...
rows.notes: Transcript "sonna konna koto tte" read as "sonna, konna koto tte".

rows.en: It's my fault I couldn't protect them.
rows.notes: What she failed to protect is not said; "them" chosen as neutral.

rows.en: Looks like the operation was a success.
I only did my duty as a pilot.
If only these victories could last forever.
No! We're too late!?
Out of time? How could this happen!?
If only we'd dealt with it sooner, this wouldn't have...
rows.notes: Subject not given; "we" (contrast 161, which says watashi).

rows.en: The operation's failed. We're returning to base at once.
If only I'd handled it better...
It's no use...
Covering fire, please.
Could you cover me from the rear?
Focus on shooting.
I'm leaving close combat to you.
I'm counting on you up front.
rows.notes: Transcript "zen-in" (everyone) is most likely "zen-ei" (vanguard), between the melee orders 166 and 168.

rows.en: Go in with melee attacks!
You, pull back!
Guard and get ready for the enemy's attack!
Regroup, quickly!
You're up.
Now! Do it!
Hit the enemy!
Stay away from me right now, for your own good!
Think you can keep up?
I'm not an ace pilot for nothing.
Roger.
OK!
Understood.
What good is a captain who can't keep it together?
rows.notes: Transcript "taichou" in the wrong kanji (physical condition); meant Captain.

rows.en: Looks like the Captain's in danger.
Are you all right, Captain?
No... the Captain was shot down?
The Captain... You're kidding, right?
To think an enemy could down the Captain...
To think a song like this exists...
A song that isn't a tool of war... I'm withdrawing.
The power of song... I never knew it was this incredible.
Keep hitting the enemy like that.
Thank you for the rescue.
Looks like I've been saved.
This is the worst. You, of all people, as my partner.
Just stay out of my way.
I don't want to fight alongside you.
From here on, I can't guarantee you'll survive.
Let's go. Are you ready?
Don't do anything reckless. Just focus on staying alive.
I'm counting on your skills.
We're going to make this operation a success.
